signature.name: VTask.IsDecompOn
signature.type: {X : Type u_1} -> {G : Type u_2} -> [SMul G X] -> (f : X → X) -> (A : Set X) -> (S : Finset G) -> Prop

conventions.statement: VTask.IsDecompOn f ∅ S holds vacuously for any f and any S, including S = ∅.
conventions.note: The universal quantifier over an empty set has no obligations.

conventions.statement: VTask.IsDecompOn f A ∅ holds if and only if A = ∅, since no element of the empty finset can witness any point.
conventions.note: The existential over an empty finset is false for every point, so the predicate forces A to be empty.

conventions.statement: The predicate is entirely unconstrained on the values of f outside A; only points in A are checked.
conventions.note: This is a purely local condition on A.

facts.statement: ∀ {X G : Type*} [inst : SMul G X] (f : X → X) (A A' : Set X) (S : Finset G), VTask.IsDecompOn f A S → A' ⊆ A → VTask.IsDecompOn f A' S

facts.statement: ∀ {X G : Type*} [inst : SMul G X] (f f' : X → X) (A A' : Set X) (S : Finset G), VTask.IsDecompOn f A S → A' ⊆ A → Set.EqOn f f' A' → VTask.IsDecompOn f' A' S

provenance.note: authored by eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6; certified by the v1.2 kernel validation ladder

facts.statement: ∀ {X G : Type*} [inst : SMul G X] [inst2 : Mul (Finset G)] (f g : X → X) (A B : Set X) (S T : Finset G), VTask.IsDecompOn f A S → VTask.IsDecompOn g B T → Set.MapsTo f A B → VTask.IsDecompOn (g ∘ f) A (T * S)

facts.statement: ∀ {X G : Type*} [inst : SMul G X] (f : X → X) (A : Set X) (S S' : Finset G), VTask.IsDecompOn f A S → S ⊆ S' → VTask.IsDecompOn f A S'

facts.statement: ∀ {X G : Type*} [inst : SMul G X] (f f' : X → X) (A : Set X) (S : Finset G), VTask.IsDecompOn f A S → Set.EqOn f f' A → VTask.IsDecompOn f' A S

facts.statement: ∀ {X G : Type*} [inst : SMul G X] [inst2 : Mul (Finset G)] (f g : X → X) (A B : Set X) (S T : Finset G), VTask.IsDecompOn f A S → VTask.IsDecompOn g B T → VTask.IsDecompOn (g ∘ f) (A ∩ f ⁻¹' B) (T * S)

facts.statement: ∀ {X G : Type*} [inst : SMul G X] [inst2 : Inv (Finset G)] (f g : X → X) (A : Set X) (S : Finset G), VTask.IsDecompOn f A S → Set.LeftInvOn g f A → VTask.IsDecompOn g (f '' A) S⁻¹
